facets.description: uploads_controller.rb lines 63-70: the fixed 5-pass 80% downsize loop can exit with the image still over max_image_size_kb, so the comment's 'automatically reduced to allowed size' promise doesn't hold and an oversized file reaches Upload.create_for
uploads_controller.rb loop: a false return from OptimizedImage.downsize (convert failure) is ignored, so the untouched original goes to Upload.create_for
